name: Pan-Roasted King Salmon with Herb Mashed Potatoes
whyItWorks: Fresh king salmon cooked gently with extra virgin olive oil provides top-grade omega-3 fats that soothe gut inflammation. Soft mashed potatoes provide easily absorbed carbohydrates.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order salmon prepared simply with olive oil and salt. Request smooth mashed potatoes and skip crispy capers or tough broccolini.
